item.title: Field Tests & Validation
item.description:
ALTER Rover V1 has been evaluated in multiple environments to validate mobility, autonomy, and robustness.

Test Scenarios

  • Rough terrain navigation
  • Obstacle traversal
  • Communication reliability under interference
  • Sensor performance in low-visibility conditions

item.title: Hardware Architecture
item.description:
Chassis & Mobility

  • Modular aluminum frame with reinforced mounts
  • All-terrain wheel system optimized for rubble and uneven surfaces
  • Suspension designed for stability during obstacle traversal

Sensors

  • 2D/3D LiDAR for mapping and obstacle detection
  • Depth & RGB cameras for perception
  • IMU and wheel encoders for state estimation

Compute & Power

  • Embedded compute unit for autonomy and perception
  • Distributed microcontroller system for motor and sensor control
  • Power-efficient battery management system for extended missions

item.title: Software Stack
item.description:
Core Stack

  • ROS 2-based modular architecture
  • Navigation and mapping pipelines
  • Teleoperation and autonomous modes

Autonomy

  • SLAM for unknown environments
  • Path planning and obstacle avoidance
  • Fail-safe state handling

Communication

  • Real-time telemetry streaming
  • Operator dashboard for situational awareness
